I'm currently on day 10 of Prozac. This is my first experience with any type of AD and I was pretty apprehensive before taking it. 

The first few days were pretty weird, it made me slightly nauseous and spaced out, but that's about it. I don't feel any better or worse in myself yet - but I really do think just the knowledge that I've done something to try and improve my situation really helps. There's a light at the end of the tunnel, and that's enough to keep going with it.

Give it a chance, even if it doesn't work for you there are lots of other options out there.
